set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement EXPORT-STATIC term 1 from protocol static
set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.template: set policy-options policy-statement [policy_statement_name] term [term_number] from protocol [protocol_name]
set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.explanation: Configures a policy statement to match routes from a specific protocol in a specific term of the policy.

parameters.name: policy_statement_name
parameters.explanation: The name of the policy statement.

parameters.name: term_number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement.

parameters.name: protocol_name
parameters.explanation: The name of the protocol from which routes are matched.

set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement EXPORT-STATIC term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.explanation: Configures a policy statement in the policy-options context, specifying a term within the policy and the action to take (accept) for that term.

parameters.name: policy-statement name
parameters.explanation: The name of the policy statement to be configured.

parameters.name: term number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to be taken for the term, such as 'accept' or 'reject'.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to take for the route (e.g., discard, reject, next-hop)

parameters.name: router-id
